## Assessment

**Champion v5_latest remains the stronger candidate** — better tuning metrics and tighter drawdown control (-9.31% vs -11.18%). The PASS candidate shows marginal lockbox improvement but at the cost of significantly worse tuning min (0.05 vs 0.43) and elevated tail risk.

- ✅ 295 loops completed
- ⏱️ ~16.5 hours remaining
- 🔄 No INCONCLUSIVE items blocking

```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

# 3. Generate diagnostic report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Ready to proceed or review specific candidate details?
